question: In which bodily centers should this moon be meditated upon by the practitioner?
premises: This moon is the object of meditation
The navel and head are specified as loci
The heart is also specified as a locus
inference: One should meditate on this moon in the navel, the head, and the heart
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate on this moon as present in the navel, in the head, and in the heart.
